Each host was individually verified against the signed CI PCR0: exact instance, Nitro chain, fresh nonce, TLS certificate and exporter binding, then strict attested-bootstrap version 2 health over the same verified connection. Separate host checks found v2-only parents, port 9101 present and plaintext port 9100 absent. Both recipient-key policies, runtime pin consumers and this public accepted set admit only this strict measurement. Both regions run the create-only CI EIF with SHA256 b0bf0713620f9ce1df123511d7066db93aebe282100c01d0eec1594ddfcb9268 (605253776 bytes), from protected-main publisher run 43995426874. transparency.newest_check: The signature proves who wrote this record and when, not that it is the newest one. Search the transparency log for the identity above; the log is append-only, so a newer entry cannot be hidden from you. The bundle carries a Signed Entry Timestamp but no inclusion proof, so confirming log membership requires querying Rekor.
